deltas.current:
import os
          from pathlib import Path
          path = Path(os.environ['ANDROID_AVD_HOME']) / 'glassnavigation.avd/config.ini'
          if not path.is_file() or any(item.is_symlink() for item in (path, *path.parents)):
              raise ValueError('The disposable AVD requires an ordinary config file and directories')
          display = {'hw.lcd.width': '1236', 'hw.lcd.height': '2676', 'hw.lcd.density': '480',
                     'hw.initialOrientation': 'Portrait', 'skin.name': '1236x2676',
                     'skin.path': '_no_skin', 'showDeviceFrame': 'no', 'hw.mainKeys': 'no'}
          lines = [line for line in path.read_text().splitlines() if line.split('=', 1)[0].strip() not in display]
          path.write_text('\n'.join(lines + [key + '=' + value for key, value in display.items()]) + '\n')
          PY
          cat > work/glass-navigation/emulator-supervisor.sh <<'SH'
          set -uo pipefail
          # ANGLE supplies GLES to Android HWUI. API 32 exercises the app's
          # CPU fallback; software GLES on API 35 is still the HWUI glass path.
          "$ANDROID_HOME/emulator/emulator" -avd glassnavigation -no-window -no-audio -no-snapshot -no-boot-anim -no-metrics -accel on -port 5554 -gpu swangle -feature -Vulkan -memory 3072 -cores 2 -prop qemu.hw.mainkeys=0 < /dev/null > work/glass-navigation/emulator.log 2>&1 &
          task_glass_pid=$!
          printf '%s\n' "$task_glass_pid" > work/glass-navigation/emulator.pid
          printf 'emulator_pid=%s\n' "$task_glass_pid"

          # These pinned images can leave the emulator property unreadable.
          # Preserve its raw value; the required per-case real Insets gates verify both bars.
          timeout 5 "$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools/adb" -s emulator-5554 shell getprop qemu.hw.mainkeys > work/glass-navigation/navigation-mainkeys.txt
          timeout 10 "$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools/adb" -s emulator-5554 shell dumpsys window displays > work/glass-navigation/navigation-boot-displays.txt
          timeout 10 "$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools/adb" -s emulator-5554 shell dumpsys window windows > work/glass-navigation/navigation-boot-windows.txt
